text:
Samira (CEO): Quick leadership note for the week. Big shoutout to the eng/runtime and ops teams for the quick cache rollback Friday — saved several customer flows. TL;DR: Private GA next week, hosted retention default change, and a few concrete asks below.

Samira (CEO): Private GA: scheduled Tue 04:00 UTC. Carlos is owning the rollout. Canary strategy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~48h with automatic rollback if error-rate > 1.2% or latency > 2x baseline. This canary window is critical 12; please avoid non-essential merges during it.

Samira (CEO): Hosted policy tweak: starting next Monday new workspaces will default to 90d data retention (was 180d). Goal: lower storage footprint and tighten our compliance posture. Ops + Comms: prepare migration guidance and an FAQ for orgs who want to retain 180d.

Samira (CEO): Quick metrics: p50 gen latency ~62ms, p95 ~210ms (weekly avg). 7d uptime: 99.96%. Optimize cost improvements: -4% WoW; target -6% by Friday. We'll track daily.

Jordan (VP Eng): Acknowledged. Freezing infra changes during the canary window. Autoscaler bump for dedicated pools is staged and will not land during canary.

Priya (VP Product): Docs and changelog teams are on it. We'll add a migration flow that allows orgs to preserve 180d data with a one-click toggle for a limited period.

Carlos (Head of Ops): Rollout plan (condensed):
- Tue 04:00 UTC: start canary at 5%
- Tue 16:00 UTC: increase to 25% if metrics pass
- Wed 04:00 UTC: ramp to 100%
- Rollback triggers: error-rate > 1.2% OR sustained latency > 2x baseline
I'll post the full playbook in #release-war-room two hours before start.

Marta (SRE): Incident recap (cache regression): root cause was a KV eviction bug triggered by the new prefix caching heuristic. Fix applied: revert heuristic and pin TTLs for hot prefixes. Postmortem draft: /docs/incidents/cache-regression-2026.md. Action items and owners:
- safelist hot prefixes: eng-runtime
- add scale regression test for prefix eviction: eng-ml
- SLI for cache-miss spike and alerting: eng-sre

Eli (Comms): Internal + customer draft ready for review: https://redwood.co/comm-drafts/private-ga-retention. Holding external send until product sign-off.

Samira (CEO): One operational ask: engineering please run the canary with a conservative quantization profile for the first 25% so we prioritize functional parity over micro-cost gains. Product & Comms, emphasize in messaging that this is a cautious rollout to protect latency and outputs.

Jordan (VP Eng): Roger. Canary kernel profile set to conservative for first two waves. Example config:
```
canary_profile: conservative
max_batch_tokens: 2048
quantization: 8bit-safe
```

Carlos (Head of Ops): DeployBot scheduled the canary: Deploy ID deploy-2839012345-private-ga, start 2026-04-07T04:00:00Z. Notifying watchers.

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy deploy-2839012345-private-ga -> start: 2026-04-07T04:00:00Z. Watchers: Samira, Jordan, Carlos, Marta.

Priya (VP Product): Sales asked for a slide that clarifies routing/fallback guarantees for Private GA; I'll sync Solutions to add it to the partner deck.

Marta (SRE): I'll add a cache-miss SLI to the dashboard and create a pager if a 5-minute spike exceeds 3x baseline.

Eli (Comms): External announcement penciled for Thursday pending product sign-off.

Samira (CEO): Two-week focus: 1) safe Private GA, 2) retention policy rollout with migration path, 3) hit -6% unit cost. I'll run a short follow-up on Friday with a scoreboard. If you see blockers for the canary or messaging, flag them now. Otherwise, execute. :thumbsup:

Jordan (VP Eng): :thumbsup:

Carlos (Head of Ops): 44d will post full canary playbook in #release-war-room 2h before the start.

Eli (Comms): will queue external announcement draft after product sign-off.

Samira (CEO): Thanks everyone. Small ask to team leads: confirm owners for the three action items in the thread replies so we have a single point of contact.
